_schema: Upcoming cohort application windows, enriched just-in-time as we work accelerators. Each entry: {accelerator, dealroom_url, cohort_name, application_open (YYYY-MM-DD), application_close (YYYY-MM-DD — the due date shown on the calendar), program_start (YYYY-MM-DD), apply_url, region}. Only application_close and accelerator are required; the rest are optional. This feeds the 'Application deadlines' calendar and, later, the public open-calls destination.
